report: Anti-RNA polymerase III systemic sclerosis with dysphagia, recent methotrexate cessation, hypertension, Raynaud’s, NSAID use, abdominal pain/bloating, and abnormal sodium/creatinine during bladder evaluation for radiation cystitis with rupture support scleroderma renal crisis as the leading diagnosis (0.6). NSAIDs/hypertension may precipitate it. Alternatives: NSAID-induced injury, scleroderma GI involvement, and radiation cystitis are less likely. Confirmatory tests pending; SRC remains most likely.
